title: Storm Opens New Gate Off the East Shoal
subtitle: Harbor Gazette · Evening edition
summary: Watchmen report a metallic shoreline beyond a new Gate.
content:
**EAST SHOAL** — During last night's storm, watchmen reported a light on the water that did not move with the waves.

By morning the Survey Office confirmed a new Gate, now designated [[g-24|G-24, the Brass Tide]]. The Watch has closed the East Shoal to small boats.

Quartermaster Varga said recovery work would be posted on the Job Board "when it is safe, or when it is profitable, whichever comes first."
author: Harbor Gazette
